title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: Atomically precise metal clusters provide more interpretable models for water-splitting structure–activity studies than polydisperse nanoparticles.
explanation: Their defined composition and crystal structures allow catalytic behavior to be related to particular metal cores, ligands, and coordination environments.
scope: Cluster-based photocatalysts for water oxidation or hydrogen evolution.
caveats: A defined precatalyst structure alone does not establish that the cluster remains intact during catalysis.
